image_description: A close-up shot of a young girl blowing soap bubbles. She is holding a green plastic bubble wand near her mouth. Several large, translucent soap bubbles are visible in the foreground and mid-ground, exhibiting strong iridescent rainbow colors (greens, pinks, blues) and reflecting/distorting the background. The largest bubble in the upper right is nearly spherical, while others are merging or distorted by motion.

The physics of the merging bubbles in the foreground is slightly ambiguous. The way the films connect lacks clear Plateau border definitions, making the structure look slightly 'mushy' or physically inconsistent.
